title: April–June 2026 Quarterly Report

metrics.label: Nikkei 225
metrics.value: Strong quarterly advance led by high-priced growth shares

metrics.label: TOPIX
metrics.value: Positive, but materially behind the Nikkei 225

metrics.label: Market structure
metrics.value: Leadership was concentrated rather than uniform

sections.heading: 1. Q2 overview: a powerful but uneven advance
body: Japanese equities rose strongly during April–June 2026. The Nikkei 225 outperformed TOPIX by a wide margin, indicating that high-priced large-cap growth stocks had an outsized influence on index performance.
The quarter should therefore not be interpreted as a uniform rise across all industries. Theme selection and stock selection remained important even while the headline indices were advancing.

sections.heading: 2. Main leadership groups
body: AI infrastructure, semiconductor equipment, memory, optical communications, power systems, and data-center-related themes attracted substantial attention.
The strongest themes combined earnings growth expectations with visible physical bottlenecks, including manufacturing capacity, power supply, cooling, advanced packaging, and networking.

sections.heading: 3. Risks carried into the next quarter
body: Rapid gains increased sensitivity to earnings disappointments, capital-expenditure delays, interest rates, and geopolitical developments.
When leadership is concentrated, reversals in a small group of large stocks can produce a much larger index decline than the broader market fundamentals would imply.

sections.heading: 4. How to evaluate the next phase
body: Monitor theme returns together with volume, trading value, breadth, earnings revisions, and order trends.
A healthy continuation would involve broader participation. A weakening market would show narrowing leadership, falling volume, and repeated failures to hold rebounds.
